title: Letter to Noah C. Saxton, 4 January 1833
source_note: JS, Letter, Kirtland Township, OH, to Noah C. Saxton, Rochester, Monroe Co., NY, 4 Jan. 1833. Retained copy, [ca. 4 Jan. 1833] in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 14–18; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams; CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
